appointment_form.instructions: Do `item.field_labels` and `item.page` show a form for requesting an appointment or consult?

free_text.instructions: Do `item.field_labels` include an open free-text box (message, how can we help) where a visitor could describe their dental problem?

asks_health_directly.instructions: Do `item.field_labels` directly ask for health details such as symptoms, treatment wanted, insurance, date of birth or medical history?
